sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: AutoGPT is a platform for a team of AI agents, called Experts, that handle content, sales, research and recurring work. You brief them in plain English, a coordinator agent called Otto hands out the work, and a visual builder lets you define repeatable workflows.
sixtySeconds.problem: Delegating recurring work to AI usually means stitching together prompts and tools yourself. AutoGPT gives you ready-made specialist agents and workflows that you can shape with instructions, context, skills and connected apps.
whoFor: Small teams delegating content, sales and admin work
People who want to self-host an agent platform
Developers using its API or MCP server
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a team-of-agents approach with a hosted option or self-hosting. Note the platform code is under the Polyform Shield license, not a standard open-source license.
requirements: Model credentials or a local model when self-hosting

overview: Each Expert has a role you can shape, such as an SEO content manager, an account executive or an executive assistant, and Otto coordinates work across them. You choose which accounts each Expert can access, set spending controls and follow their activity. Routines handle jobs that keep coming back.

The hosted AutoGPT Platform is a paid service that includes model access. Self-hosting runs on your own infrastructure with a single Docker container, an installer for Linux, macOS and Windows, or Docker Compose with each service separate; you provide the model credentials.

Experts can use workflows built in the visual builder, adapted from the marketplace, connected to integrations, or run through the API and MCP server. The platform folder is under Polyform Shield (free for personal and internal business use, not for competing hosted services); AutoGPT Classic and the rest are MIT.

steps.title: Start AutoGPT
steps.code:
docker run -d \
  --name autogpt \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  --shm-size 2g \
  --ulimit nofile=65536:65536 \
  --log-driver json-file \
  --log-opt max-size=50m \
  --log-opt max-file=5 \
  -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 \
  -e AUTOGPT_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3000 \
  -v autogpt-data:/data \
  significantgravitas/autogpt:latest
